before.name: CMS website development
before.h1: CMS website development. An editor for your team.
before.lead: Give your team a website they can edit. We can improve a WordPress site or build a custom Next.js website with a Sanity editor. We scope the pages, content model, publishing workflow and handover together, including a content and URL plan if you are moving platforms.
before.problemHeading: What should your team be able to edit?
before.problemIntro: Begin with everyday changes: a new service, an image, a team member or an article. We separate editable content from new design and functionality.
before.detailsHeading: Website, editor and handover in one scope.

after.name: CMS website development
after.h1: CMS website development. An editor for your team.
after.lead: CMS website development for a team that needs easier content editing. We can improve a suitable WordPress editor or build a custom Next.js website with Sanity. Agree the pages, publishing tasks, migration and training together before work starts.
after.problemHeading: What should your team be able to edit?
after.problemIntro: Begin with everyday changes: a new service, an image, a team member or an article. We separate editable content from new design and functionality.
after.detailsHeading: CMS development, editor setup and handover.

buyerQuestions.q: Can you improve a website that is difficult to update?
buyerQuestions.a: Yes. We begin with the changes your team needs to make: words, images, services, team members or articles. We can improve a suitable existing editor or build the agreed website and Sanity editing workflow together. You review the fields and publishing tasks before launch, with training and written instructions. New layouts or functionality are scoped separately.

before.name: Backend development
before.category: Backend development for portals, CRMs & internal tools
before.lead: Your app needs a database, sign-in, file storage and the rules behind the screens. We usually build on Supabase, because it's quick to set up and the data is yours: it's Postgres underneath. We often build a custom CRM on top, so your team runs the business from its own admin screens. If the project needs a different database or an API you already have, we build around that instead.
before.problemHeading: Who can do what with each record?
before.problemIntro: Managed database and authentication services provide useful foundations. The application still needs a data model, access rules and behavior when something fails.

after.name: Backend development
after.category: Backend development for portals, CRMs & internal tools
after.h1: Backend development. Logins, data and workflows.
after.lead: Backend development for customer logins, private uploads, business records and connected tools. We usually build on Supabase, or work with your existing database and APIs. The quote names the data, access rules, integrations and admin screens your application needs.
after.problemHeading: Who can do what with each record?
after.problemIntro: Managed database and authentication services provide useful foundations. The application still needs a data model, access rules and behavior when something fails.

buyerQuestions.q: Can you add customer logins and private file uploads to our website?
buyerQuestions.a: Yes, as a separately scoped backend or portal project. We agree the user roles, records, files and actions each person may access, then implement and test the permissions and connections to your website. Supabase is our usual platform, but we assess your existing database and APIs first. A content editor or Starter website does not automatically include this application work.

before.name: WordPress websites
before.h1: A WordPress site. Made for your business.
before.lead: Need a straightforward business website, a blog or a refresh of what you have? We design and build on WordPress when it fits. Work directly with Hassan and Imran, agree the pages and price, and learn how to update the site yourself.
before.problemHeading: The pages you need. An editor you can use.
before.problemIntro: Start with what you want people to understand, buy or ask about. We help you decide what belongs on the site and which parts your team needs to change.

after.name: WordPress websites
after.h1: WordPress development. New sites and redesigns.
after.lead: WordPress website design and development for small businesses. Build a new site, refresh an outdated design or investigate slow pages and broken forms. Work directly with the founders, agree the scope and price, and learn how to update the site yourself.
after.problemHeading: Need a new WordPress site or help with the one you have?
after.problemIntro: We review your pages, mobile layout, editing tasks and enquiry forms. A focused repair, redesign or new build gets its own scope; a platform move is considered when it serves the requirements.

buyerQuestions.q: Can you fix a slow WordPress website without rebuilding it?
buyerQuestions.a: Yes, when the cause can be addressed on the existing site. We review representative pages, the theme, plugins, images and hosting before quoting a focused improvement. A new website or migration is a separate option when the current setup cannot meet the agreed requirements. We measure before promising a performance change.

before.name: Custom software
before.h1: Custom software. Built around the work.
before.lead: A dashboard, portal or internal tool should fit the people using it. We map the job first, then build the smallest useful system with a clear handover.
before.problemHeading: Build around the work people do.
before.problemIntro: Start with real tasks, handoffs and decisions. The useful system is one your team can trust on an ordinary Tuesday.
before.detailsHeading: What kind of system are we scoping?

after.name: Custom software
after.h1: Custom software development. Portals and internal tools.
after.lead: Need a customer portal, staff dashboard or a way to stop copying records between spreadsheets? We map the workflow, users and data, then scope a useful first release with the screens, integrations and handover your team needs.
after.problemIntro: Start with the records people retype, the approvals they wait for and the information customers need. We agree one complete workflow before expanding the application.
after.detailsHeading: What kind of system are we scoping?

buyerQuestions.q: Can you replace spreadsheets with a customer portal or staff dashboard?
buyerQuestions.a: Yes, when a defined application solves the workflow. We map the records, repeated data entry, approvals and users, then scope one complete process for the first release. The quote lists the screens, permissions, integrations, data migration and ongoing costs. Your team reviews a working workflow before launch rather than buying an undefined software package.

before.name: E-commerce
before.h1: Ecommerce stores. Built around the order.
before.lead: Start a store or improve one you already run. Product discovery, checkout and the work after purchase should form one clear journey.
before.problemHeading: Follow the customer and the order.
before.problemIntro: The right work may be a product page, a checkout fix or a new storefront. We look at the full path before proposing a rebuild.

after.name: E-commerce
after.h1: Ecommerce development. For the way you sell.
after.lead: Build or redesign an online store with Shopify, WooCommerce or a custom storefront where it fits. We scope product pages, mobile shopping, checkout and order handling together, or improve the store you already run.
after.problemIntro: We review how customers find products, choose options and complete checkout, then inspect the handoff to your team. The quote separates a focused improvement from a new storefront.

buyerQuestions.q: Can you improve an online store that is difficult to buy from?
buyerQuestions.a: Yes. We review product pages, mobile navigation, cart, checkout and the order handoff, then quote the changes needed for the agreed purchase journey. Shopify or WooCommerce can remain the store backend where it fits. A focused improvement and a new storefront are separate scopes; neither comes with a sales guarantee.

before.name: WooCommerce
before.h1: Your WooCommerce store. Built for buyers.
before.lead: Starting a store, improving one, or considering a different storefront? We review products, checkout and the work after each order, then help you choose what to keep and what to change.
before.problemIntro: Cart and checkout need a live session, so a cached homepage cannot settle the question. We review your own purchase path and the systems attached to it.
before.detailsHeading: A store move is more than a new theme.

after.name: WooCommerce
after.h1: WooCommerce development. Build, improve or migrate.
after.lead: WooCommerce development services for new stores and existing shops. Need help with slow product pages, checkout or connected extensions? We review the purchase journey and order handling, then quote improvements or a rebuild that fits.
after.problemHeading: Slow checkout or a store that is hard to run?
after.problemIntro: Cart and checkout need a live session, so a cached homepage cannot settle the question. We review your own purchase path and the systems attached to it.
after.detailsHeading: Build, improve or migrate your WooCommerce store.

buyerQuestions.q: Can you fix a slow WooCommerce checkout without replacing the store?
buyerQuestions.a: We assess that first. WooCommerce checkout depends on live customer sessions, payment connections, extensions and hosting, so a cached homepage score is not enough. We test the agreed product-to-order path and quote repairs on the existing store when they meet the need. A custom storefront or platform move is proposed separately, with checkout and extension compatibility checked before committing.

before.name: Wix websites & migration
before.lead: Build or improve your Wix website, or migrate to a custom site with a Sanity editor your team can use. We review content, forms, integrations and redirects before recommending a move.
before.problemHeading: What should your website help you do?
before.problemIntro: A platform change should serve a clear need. We review the current site, the plan you pay for and the tasks your team wants to handle more easily.

after.name: Wix design, redesign & migration
after.h1: Wix website design. Redesign or move.
after.lead: Need a Wix website redesign, a clearer mobile layout or forms that work with your business? We can build or improve the current site, or plan a custom website with a Sanity editor if you have outgrown the setup.
after.problemHeading: Outdated design, slow pages or awkward mobile layouts?
after.problemIntro: We review the pages, mobile experience, enquiries and editing tasks before recommending a Wix redesign or platform move. The quote names the changes and connected apps involved.
after.detailsHeading: What your Wix redesign or migration covers.

buyerQuestions.q: Can you redesign my Wix website without moving platforms?
buyerQuestions.a: Yes. We can scope a Wix redesign around the pages, mobile layout, content and forms you need while keeping the platform. We check the editor and connected Wix apps before pricing the work. If a required workflow cannot be supported in that setup, we explain the alternative and its costs before you decide.

before.name: Squarespace websites & migration
before.h1: Your Squarespace site. Built for more.
before.lead: Build or improve your Squarespace website, or move to a custom site with a Sanity editor. We map content, commerce, scheduling and redirects, then compare the build and running costs.
before.problemIntro: A custom site makes sense when it supports work the current setup cannot easily handle. We review your content, commerce, editing and connected services first.

after.name: Squarespace design, redesign & migration
after.lead: Build or redesign a Squarespace website around your services, content and enquiries. If layouts, editing or connected tools are getting in the way, we compare improvements with a custom site and Sanity editor before you choose.
after.problemHeading: Does your Squarespace site still fit your business?
after.problemIntro: We review the design, mobile pages, content, forms and scheduling. A redesign can stay on Squarespace; a move needs a separate plan for the features and content your team relies on.
after.detailsHeading: What your Squarespace redesign or move covers.

buyerQuestions.q: Can you redesign my Squarespace website without starting over?
buyerQuestions.a: Often, yes. We review the current version, page layouts, style settings, content and connected services, then agree what can be improved on the existing site. A redesign does not automatically require leaving Squarespace. A platform move receives a separate content, URL and feature plan if the requirements justify it.

before.name: Webflow websites & migration
before.lead: Planning a website, refining a live Webflow site, or considering a move? We look at pages, publishing and connected tools, then compare improvements with a new build where useful.
before.problemHeading: Review the site you actually run.
before.problemIntro: A speed score or a new plan alone is not a reason to migrate. We look at publishing work, connected services and your actual bill.
before.detailsHeading: Code export is one part of a Webflow move.

after.name: Webflow development & redesign
after.h1: Webflow development. Build, improve or move.
after.lead: Webflow development and redesign for a new website or an existing site that needs attention. We review mobile layouts, CMS editing, forms and integrations, then scope improvements or a move to a custom build when it fits.
after.problemHeading: Difficult editing, broken forms or a redesign backlog?
after.problemIntro: We inspect the pages and publishing tasks causing the problem. Your current Webflow setup may only need focused changes; a migration receives its own content, interaction and integration plan.
after.detailsHeading: Webflow development, CMS changes and migration.

buyerQuestions.q: Can you improve a Webflow site our team struggles to update?
buyerQuestions.a: Yes. We review the CMS fields, page templates, publishing tasks and account access that are causing difficulty, then scope changes to the current site where they fit. Your team gets a demonstration of the agreed editing tasks. New templates, integrations or a move to another CMS are separately defined in the proposal.

before.name: GoHighLevel
before.h1: GoHighLevel websites. Speed, builds and CRM.
before.lead: Is your GoHighLevel site slow, or have you outgrown the builder? We review the cause, then scope improvements or a custom site that keeps your CRM, forms, calendars and pipelines connected.
before.problemHeading: Follow the enquiry end to end.
before.problemIntro: The public page and the CRM are two parts of one customer journey. We check the connection before proposing a new frontend.
before.detailsHeading: Keep the CRM work that matters.

after.name: GoHighLevel
after.h1: GoHighLevel websites. Keep your CRM. Improve the site.
after.lead: Is your GoHighLevel website slow, or have you outgrown the builder? We scope page improvements or a custom site connected to your GHL forms, calendars and pipelines. Forms and bookings are tested against the agreed account and workflows.
after.problemHeading: Slow pages or missing GoHighLevel enquiries?
after.problemIntro: We follow a visitor from the website to the correct CRM account, booking and follow-up workflow. The assessment separates public-page problems from integration work before a fix or new site is quoted.
after.detailsHeading: Keep the CRM work that matters.

buyerQuestions.q: Can you fix a slow GoHighLevel website and keep the CRM?
buyerQuestions.a: Yes, that is an option we assess. We review the public pages, images, scripts and form or calendar connections to identify the problem. We can scope improvements to the existing pages or a custom website connected to the agreed GoHighLevel account. The CRM, pipelines and automations are reviewed and tested within the written scope; a rebuild alone does not guarantee a faster site.

before.name: AI SEO
before.h1: AI SEO. Answers people can find.
before.lead: We research what buyers ask, improve the pages that answer them and check what search and AI systems can access. Monthly work starts at $500.
before.problemIntro: A page can render perfectly and still omit the price basis, delivery constraint or detail a buyer needs. We work from real questions and evidence.

after.name: AI SEO
after.h1: AI SEO services. Useful answers. Clear scope.
after.lead: AI SEO, answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) services for your business website. We research buyer questions, improve agreed pages and report available visibility signals. Monthly work starts at $500.
after.problemHeading: Is your business missing from AI answers?
after.problemIntro: We review the questions buyers ask, whether search systems can access the answers and which useful business facts are missing. One agreed improvement is implemented and verified within the monthly starting scope.

buyerQuestions.q: Can you help if my business is missing from ChatGPT or Google AI answers?
buyerQuestions.a: We can investigate the agreed questions and pages, check access to the content and identify missing or unsupported business information. The monthly starting scope includes focused research, monitoring, one implemented improvement, a report and a review. We report observed visibility separately from visits and enquiries; no service can guarantee that an AI system will include or cite your business.

buyerQuestions.q: What are AEO and GEO services?
buyerQuestions.a: Answer engine optimization (AEO) and generative engine optimization (GEO) describe work aimed at making useful business information accessible to answer and AI search systems. PandaCodeGen includes this work within its AI SEO service: research buyer questions, improve the agreed pages and report available visibility signals. It is a scoped service for your website, rather than a subscription to automated SEO software.

migrationBuyerQuestions.q: Is moving WordPress to Next.js the same as changing hosts?
migrationBuyerQuestions.a: No. A host-to-host move keeps the WordPress software, theme and plugins. PandaCodeGen's WordPress-to-Next.js service rebuilds the website on a different framework and agrees how content, editing, URLs and features will work. We explain the rebuild price and ongoing costs before you choose; changing platforms is not necessary just because a host needs replacing.
